_comment: Copy to config/artists.json. This file is gitignored - it maps your roster.
Sprout knows profiles, not artists. The app folds profiles into artists by
matching profile names, which handles most of the roster automatically. Use
this file for the two things it cannot do:
1. pin profiles whose handles don't match across networks
2. attach Chartmetric and RealCount ids, which Sprout has no idea about
Run `npm run verify:apis` first - it prints your group IDs, every profile,
and which artists are missing ids.

artists.name: Example Artist
artists._accountTypes: Only needed when the automatic classification gets it wrong. The Accounts tab in the UI does the same thing without editing this file.
